name: Saudi Qaid Transport Company
note: Sleeve sponsor of several Saudi Pro League clubs (Al-Khaleej, Al-Kholood, Al-Ettifaq, and from December 2025 Al-Ahli, under a three-year deal with its logo on the shoulder of the first team's jersey). The company's site (qaid.sa) describes a Makkah-based bus-transport business but names no owner, so it stays not rated yet.
